event.description: Factor tied token input and output through rank 7
event.proposal: family: token representation; current retained incumbent is 3136 parameters at 99.9500%, a +0.95 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0002, reversed operand token order at 5056/99.98%; same-family failed result: attempt-0013, rank-6 tied token/output factorization at 4234/9.68%; prior attempts in this family: 2. Hypothesis: the earlier rank-6 collapse was measured before the successful MQA, affine-free pre-norm, per-head output, and ff16 changes; a less aggressive rank-7 factorization may retain the token distinctions needed by this newer 3136-parameter regime while reducing the tied token representation from 240 to 217 parameters, yielding 3113 total. This is more informative than retrying rank6 because rank7 is the nearest less-compressed representation and separates rank capacity from the older attention context; the nearest untested alternative is a rank-8 factor, which is not a parameter reduction at d16. Keep reversed operands, learned positions, d16/h2/L2, independent head-local output maps, MQA, affine-free block pre-norms, final affine norm, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 3136 parameters.
